content: I created a cloud vendor agnostic security project that is now focused only on AWS IAM: https://www.zerodrift.dev/iam-lean/catalog.html This is the current documentation based on blueprint. The project is https://github.com/sufield/iam-lean You can run it locally and check if any IAM policy obeys the least privilege principle. The code is very verbose and I am thinking about using aeosp to reduce the amount of code. I appreciate any feedback.
